source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/screens/14-account.png (artboard image is the authority per SETUP); dc.html id="p14"; README screen 14
notes: Region-composition check for the full page: AppShell + the real UserProfilePage (its own internal Masthead + merged tab row), populated fixture data via .discipline/rendering/audit/mounts.mjs['compose-account'] — no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md); this mount's org endpoints (/api/orgs/org-1, /members, /invitations) are mocked with dc.html p14's own illustrated fixture (2 members, both Owner; Dietl / Rockit, enterprise plan) instead.

Artboard order: Masthead -> merged 8-entry tab row (Personal/Organization/Members & roles·2/Sector profile·6/Jurisdictions·30/Verifier badge/Activity/Settings) -> 2-column grid (content 1fr / 300px rail) -> left column: Members & roles card THEN Organization card stacked directly below it (dc.html's own illustrated tab is Members & roles, not Personal) -> rail: 2x2 stat grid (Sectors followed/Home jurisdictions/Member since/Plan) -> Admin card (owner/admin only) -> Quick links card (Dashboard / Settings / Watchlist, 3 items).

This lane fixed four real defects: (1) the page used to render a single-column layout — an owner-banner strip above a `repeat(4,1fr)` stat row above the tab body, no rail — replaced with dc.html's own 2-column grid (minmax(0,1fr) 300px) with the stat grid / Admin card / Quick links card as a RAIL persistent across every tab, not stacked above the content in one column. (2) The rail's 4th stat tile used to be a conditional 'Admin attention'/'Account role' tile; dc.html's 4th tile is 'Plan' (org billing plan) — added an `organizations.plan` read and swapped the tile. (3) QuickLinksRail (persistent in the rail now) used to duplicate itself inside the Personal tab's own body AND carried 5-6 two-line entries (Dashboard/Regulations/Market intel/Map/Settings/Admin panel) that dc.html does not show; fixed to dc.html's own exact 3 single-line links (Dashboard / Settings · notifications, briefing schedule / Watchlist), rendered once, persistently, in the rail only. (4) The Members & roles tab used to render only MembersPanel; dc.html p14 illustrates Organization stacked directly below it on that same tab (Organization keeps its own separate tab too, unaffected) — added.

Not a composition defect, left as the real page's own behavior: the Masthead's dateLabel here is computed from the live current date (Intl formatLocaleDate(new Date())), not a passed-in fixture string like Map/Community/Admin's mounts use, UserProfilePage.tsx has never taken a dateLabel prop, unlike AdminDashboard; changing that is a component-level decision outside this composition-only pass, and the visual difference (today's real weekday/date vs the artboard's fixed 'Sunday 6 September 2026') is expected and not asserted by this spec.

Lane admin60 (2026-09-08) closed the five differences the train-59 fold listed against this artboard. (1) The invite row carries dc.html p14's own 'INVITE BY EMAIL' field label, its 'name@company.com' placeholder and its 'Send invite' button, laid out 1fr/auto to the field baseline. (2) The member list IS the artboard's table now: the shared RowTable under MEMBER / JOINED / ROLE headers on dc.html's own track list (1fr 120px 150px 44px), with the trailing 44px overflow cell; Remove and Ban moved off the row as text buttons into that overflow menu (R7's precedent; the overlay's own styling is left exactly as RowTable ships it, per 'overlays: unchanged and undesigned, do not invent'). The row's second line is the artboard's 'you · <email>' on the reader's own row, not a repeat of the ROLE column. (3) The seat foot strip is built as a neutral StateNote where the artboard draws one; the seat clause has NO data path (no seats / seat_limit / max_members column exists in the schema or in any /api/orgs payload, re-checked this lane), so it renders the Absence convention with reason 'connect data' and no 'Manage seats' link, there being no seats route and a dead control being a defect (ruling 1.1). (4) The identity table and workspace-scope footnote that used to sit ABOVE ORGANIZATION's two fields, where the artboard has nothing, moved BELOW them as a card-foot disclosure under ruling R7. (5) The rail's four stat blocks are ONE card with a 2x2 grid inside, as drawn, not four separate bordered cards.

Also this lane, both shared parts and both artboard-driven: AccountCard's head meta is 10.5px / .12em small caps (it read as body copy in sentence case), and the card head sits on the card's own white rather than a raised plate.
